reference: Alexiad, Book X, ch. 5 (Greek 10.5.6; el.wikisource Αλεξιάς Βιβλίο 10); Dawes 1928 Book X
gist_en: Anna says the barbarian Ishmaelites are slaves to wine and Dionysus and worship Astarte, valuing the image of the moon; a sneer at Muslim customs and lineage.
why_excluded: Ethnic and customary abuse of Arabs or Turks (the 'Ishmaelites') described as filthy and idolatrous; not a doctrinal argument. Rule 3.

reference: Synaxaristes ton dodeka menon, vol. II, 15 December (entry for St Bacchos of Jerusalem, Saracen rule)
gist_en: A converted Jewish martyr at Jerusalem calls the faith of the Agarenes false and vain, mocks it, and is beheaded under Muslim rule.
why_excluded: Out of period: martyr under early Arab rule of Jerusalem, well before 1084 and before the 1500-1700 focus; the author is not a post-Schism Orthodox writer. Date not verified in the text.

gist_en: Cypriot Greek scholar and educator who converted from Orthodoxy to Catholicism and preached as a Catholic missionary in Italy, Poland, Greece, Turkey and Albania.
why_excluded: Converted to Catholicism (Latin-rite writer); the brief excludes Greeks who converted to Catholicism.
